description: This source file defines the MediaStep class, a recipe step handler for media file processing in OrchardCore, including methods for handling media files from various sources (Base64, local path, URL) and related nested classes for modeling media files.

classes.name: MediaStep
classes.description: A recipe step handler that processes media files, supporting sources like Base64, local files, and URLs, and saves them to media storage.

classes.name: MediaStepModel
classes.description: Model representing a collection of media files to process.

classes.name: MediaStepFile
classes.description: Model representing individual media file details, including target path and source information.

methods.name: MediaStep
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for media processing.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method handling the media file processing logic during recipe execution.
